 Order

This writ petition has been filed for a direction to the respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 09.09.2023 and for a consequential direction to the respondent to disburse the compensation amount for the land acquired.

2. The case of the petitioner is that she is the owner of the land measuring an extent of 2400 Sq.ft.,
situated at Sri Mahalakshmi Nagar (DTCP approved No. CR/DT & Cp/M/LP.17), comprised in S.Nos.249/3 and 249/5, Sub-divded S.No.249/15 in Eraiyoor Village, Vaipoor  B Block, Old Sriperumbudur Tauk, presently Kundrathur Taluk, Kancheepuram District and she purchased the same vide registered sale deed Doc No.2226/2008 on the file of Sub Registrar office,
Sriperumbudur.
The Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation had acquired the land belonging to the petitioner for Industrial Purpose in the year 2015 through Acquisition intimation letter dated 09.02.2015.

T h e g r i e v a n c e o f t h e p e t i t i o n e r i s t h a t s h e h a s n o t r e c e i v e d a n y F o r m https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis I/Form II notice with regard to the compensation amount.

The petitioner in this regard had also submitted a representation to the respondent on 09.09.2023,
seeking for compensation.
Since the respondent did not act upon the said representation of the petitioner, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court seeking for appropriate direction.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondent.
4.

Though the respondent has filed a counter affidavit, they had not given any details about the service of notice and hence, there shall be a direction to the respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 09.09.2023, on its own merits and in accordance with law and also provide all xerox copies of served documents to the petitioner, within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
This writ petition is disposed of with the above directions.
No costs.
